title: Repeated capability reads are deterministic and have no device side effects
blocker: Pure evaluator and snapshot-store component tests cover deterministic reads, but the production API, cache, inventory publisher and host agent are not integrated under live counter, driver, lease and reset observations.
assertions: repeated reads of one immutable publisher snapshot produce the same semantic and decision hashes
capability reads do not bind, unbind, reset, open exclusive VFIO handles, mutate leases or increment device generations
availability changes may change the executable decision while leaving the hardware capability projection unchanged
a concurrent complete snapshot publication yields either the old complete epoch or the new complete epoch, never a mixed view
